data.title: Make shibuya sub-site more realistic — denser, more physical street scene

data.body: User request: 'let's make shibuya more realistic'. Current page implements BRANDING.md faithfully but the scene reads sparse: canyon walls are near-empty asphalt planes (2 stacks x 3 signs per mid band), no building structure (floors/windows/storefronts), ground reflections barely present (--wet used once), far band is a few abstract bulbs. Goal: push toward the real optical density of the street — packed signage, visible building fabric, wet-street light reflections, richer far-distance texture — while staying inside BRANDING.md constraints (palette, sign species, one flicker, static scene, contract in root CLAUDE.md). Must run node build.js and keep standalone + built pages working.

Implemented the FA-29 plan: added .canyon-road wet ground plane (same vanishing point, vertical reflection streaks + hue smears), wall window fabric (mullions, 9vh floors, lit windows, storefront spill via .wall-windows), densified mid bands to 4 stacks/wall with new .wtube/.wlantern species, densified far bands (4 stacks + scale(0.6) .band-deep, new .bulb-dot/.bulb-col), warmed/widened canyon-end, street-glow streaks; .wallstack-x hides extras below 700px. Sky band and power lines considered and cut per plan §5. Verified: node build.js clean; automated hue-adjacency audit PASS (20 stacks, vertical + horizontal incl. off-by-one rows); all selectors prefixed #site-shibuya; only shibuya-* keyframes; no functional-pseudo-class commas; tag balance OK; zero new ids/keyframes/animations; script.js byte-identical. Commit bf5c7c0.

REVIEW (commit bf5c7c0, cold read of plan + diff + BRANDING.md 3.5/7/9/10 + root authoring contract). Verified independently: (1) node build.js reproduces the committed root index.html byte-identically (git diff clean apart from .lattice bookkeeping); (2) script.js and the entire near/readable .street layer untouched in the diff; (3) zero new ids, zero new @keyframes (only the five pre-existing shibuya-* remain), zero new animations; only @media at-rules added; no commas in functional pseudo-classes; no literal style/script closers; (4) geometry: .canyon-road is a direct child of .canyon (first child, so walls paint over it - correct occlusion), rotateX under the single shared perspective, no preserve-3d, no translateZ, no position:fixed anywhere, overflow:clip still on .canyon, no filter on .canyon itself (the brightness(0.92) sits on the road leaf, which 7.3 permits); (5) bans: no sky (walls full height, terminus is the widened warm haze), road carries vertical wet streaks only - no cross lines, mullion+slab grid is 4% white building fabric not a glowing synthwave grid, all wall content inside the aria-hidden canyon, reduced-motion block still covers every animated element and all additions are static paint; (6) hue adjacency audited by hand: far stacks are rotations of a 6-hue cycle at offsets L(0,3,1,4)+deep(1,4), R(2,5,1,4)+deep(1,4) - no consecutive repeats, and offset deltas of 2-4 mod 6 rule out same/adjacent-index horizontal collisions; mid stacks pass vertically and the 9/3.5/12vh staggers resolve the near-miss horizontal pairs (e.g. karaoke s1[2] vs s2[0]); lanterns 1 per wall; (7) rendered standalone at 1280/375/320 and the built root at 1450 in headless Chrome: one vanishing point dead centre, road converging on it, hero forrest-almasi still on near-dark backdrop (7.3 rule 2 ok), scene visibly denser; measured scrollWidth at 320px = 320/320, no horizontal overflow; below 700px wallstack-x hides (mid back to 2 stacks) and the road shortens. Minor notes, no action needed: two mid stacks carry 6 items vs 3.5's three-to-five (consistent with pre-existing far stacks; scenery approximation), and power lines were considered-and-cut per plan (agree with the cut). Verdict: PASS - meets the plan's acceptance criteria; moving to done.
